description: This source file defines the MessagingTrace class, which implements diagnostic and logging functionalities for messaging within the Orleans runtime. It contains event definitions, log message configurations, and methods for tracing message-related events such as sending, receiving, dropping, enqueueing, and handling messages and their various phases.

classes.name: MessagingTrace
classes.description: A class for tracing and logging messaging events within the Orleans runtime, implementing both diagnostic and logging interfaces.

methods.name: OnSendMessage
methods.description: Logs the event of sending a message.

methods.name: OnIncomingMessageAgentReceiveMessage
methods.description: Logs the receipt of a message by the incoming message agent.

methods.name: OnDispatcherReceiveMessage
methods.description: Logs the reception of a message by the dispatcher.

methods.name: OnDropExpiredMessage
methods.description: Logs the dropping of an expired message at a specific phase.

methods.name: OnDropBlockedApplicationMessage
methods.description: Logs the dropping of a message due to application blocking.

methods.name: OnSiloDropSendingMessage
methods.description: Logs the event of a silo dropping a message with a reason.

methods.name: OnEnqueueInboundMessage
methods.description: Logs the enqueueing of an inbound message.

methods.name: OnDequeueInboundMessage
methods.description: Logs the dequeueing of an inbound message.

methods.name: OnEnqueueMessageOnActivation
methods.description: Logs enqueueing of a message on activation context.

methods.name: OnRejectSendMessageToDeadSilo
methods.description: Logs rejection of sending a message to a dead silo.

methods.name: OnSendRequest
methods.description: Logs sending of a request message.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a certain log level is enabled.
